## What's new in 0.5.0

### Fixed
- The timeline jumps at once when you skip forward or back, instead of once the video has loaded.
- On phones, letting go of the timeline jumps the video there again.


## Install

**Windows:** download **B-Anime-Setup-0.5.0.exe** below and run it. It installs for your user only, without admin rights. Already have B-Anime? It updates itself.

> **Windows says "Windows protected your PC"?** Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. B-Anime isn't code-signed yet, so Windows doesn't know the publisher. The installer is the one built by this repository's release workflow; you can check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

**Android:** download **B-Anime-0.5.0-arm64.apk** below (arm64, for most phones). The first time, your phone asks you to allow installing from this source. Installed copies update themselves.

**Mac (Apple Silicon):** `brew install --cask ahmedanjum30/tap/b-anime`. Or download **B-Anime-0.5.0-macos.zip** below, unzip it and drag the app to Applications; the first time, right-click it and choose **Open**. Installed copies update themselves.
